# UCP JSON Schemas (test fixtures)

Unmodified copies of the Universal Commerce Protocol schemas that `ucp_profile_schema_test` validates `/.well-known/ucp` against, so the test runs offline.

- Source: `https://ucp.dev/2026-08-25/schemas/` (release [`v2026-08-25`](https://github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp/releases/tag/v2026-08-25))
- License: Apache-2.0, © the Universal Commerce Protocol authors

When the orchestrator adopts a new UCP version, add that version's schemas beside this one rather than editing these files.
